response.justification: Although Bogdan has extensive software engineering experience, strong software craftsmanship skills, and a solid background in distributed systems, he falls significantly short of the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming. His career is primarily centered around Node.js, TypeScript, and DLang, with only brief professional exposure to C/C++ over a decade ago. Consequently, he is not a suitable fit for this C++ heavy Cloud Compute Technical Lead role.
strengths: Over 15 years of software development experience with a strong focus on distributed systems and microservices.
Demonstrated commitment to software craftsmanship, best practices (TDD, CI/CD), and developer tooling.
Active mentor and community contributor with experience running workshops and organizing coding dojos.
concerns: Severely lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, with less than a year of professional C++ listed.
Lacks dedicated experience as a Technical Lead specifically managing an internal cloud compute platform.
Recent technology stack leans heavily toward web-centric technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than deep compute or hardware architecture.
